description_en: Queries file systems and mount targets by calling ListFileSystemWithMountTargets
description_zh: 调用ListFileSystemWithMountTargets查询文件系统和挂载点
name: ListFileSystemWithMountTargets

parameters.help_en: The page number for the paging query
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的行数。取值范围：1~50默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

BandWidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the file system. Unit: MB/s

Capacity.description_en: The capacity of the file system. Unit: GiB

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the file system was created. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
CreateTime.description_zh: 文件系统创建时间。时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

Destription.description_en: The description of the file system

EncryptType.description_en:
Indicates whether the file system is encrypted.

A key hosted by Key Management Service (KMS) is used to encrypt data stored on the file system. Encrypted data does not need to be decrypted during read and write operations.

Valid values:

0 (default): Not encrypted.
1: NAS-managed key. This value is supported when FileSystemType is set to standard or extreme.
2: User-managed key. This value is supported only when FileSystemType is set to extreme
EncryptType.description_zh:
文件系统是否加密。

使用KMS服务托管密钥，对文件系统落盘数据进行加密存储。在读写加密数据时，无需解密。

取值：

0（默认值）：不加密。
1：NAS托管密钥。当FileSystemType=standard或extreme时，支持NAS托管密钥。
2：用户管理密钥。仅当FileSystemType=extreme时，支持用户管理密钥

FileSystemType.description_en:
The file system type. Valid values:

standard: General-purpose NAS
extreme: Extreme NAS
<props="china">
cpfs: CPFS</props>
FileSystemType.description_zh:
文件系统类型，可能值：

standard：通用型NAS
extreme：极速型NAS
<props="china">
cpfs：CPFS</props>

MeteredSize.description_en: The used capacity of the NAS file system. Unit: bytes
MeteredSize.description_zh: NAS文件系统已使用的容量，单位为Byte

AccessGroup.description_en:
Indicates whether the permission group is the default permission group of the user.

Valid values:

true: The permission group is the default permission group. When the permission group is the default permission group, all IP addresses are allowed to access the file system, and you cannot delete the default permission group or the permission rules in the group.
false: The permission group is not the default permission group
AccessGroup.description_zh:
权限组是否为用户的默认权限组。

包括：

true：该权限组为默认权限组。当该权限组为默认权限组时，允许所有IP地址访问，且用户无法删除默认权限组及权限组内的权限规则。
false：该权限组不是默认权限组

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values:
vpc: VPC
classic: classic network
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型。可能值：
vpc：专有网络
classic：经典网络

Status.description_en:
The mount target status. Valid values:
Active: Available.
Inactive: Unavailable.
Pending: The task is queued.
Deleting: The mount target is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
挂载点状态。可能值：
Active：可用
Inactive：不可用
Pending：任务排队中
Deleting：删除中

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type of the file system. Valid values:

NFS
SMB
<props="china">
CPFS</props>
ProtocolType.description_zh:
文件系统的协议类型。可能值：

NFS- SMB
<props="china">
CPFS</props>

Status.description_en:
The file system status. Valid values:
Pending: The file system is processing a task.
Running: The file system is available.
Stopped: The file system is unavailable.
Extending: The file system is being scaled out.
Stopping: The file system is being stopped.
Deleting: The file system is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
文件系统状态。可能值：
Pending：当前文件系统正在处理任务中。
Running：当前文件系统可用。
Stopped：当前文件系统不可用。
Extending：当前文件系统扩容中。
Stopping：当前文件系统停机中。
Deleting：当前文件系统删除中

StorageType.description_en:
The storage specification type.

If FileSystemType is set to standard, valid values: Capacity and Performance.
If FileSystemType is set to extreme, valid values: standard and advance.
<props="china">
If FileSystemType is set to CPFS, valid values: advance_100 (100 MB/s/TiB baseline) and advance_200 (200 MB/s/TiB baseline).</props>
StorageType.description_zh:
存储规格类型。

当FileSystemType为standard时，可能值：Capacity（容量型）、Performance（性能型）
当FileSystemType为extreme时，可能值：standard（标准型）、advance（高级型）
<props="china">
当FileSystemType为CPFS时，可能值：advance_100（100MB/s/TiB基线）、advance_200（200MB/s/TiB基线）</props>

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the paging query

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in the paging query. Settings: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围：1~50。 默认值：10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
